title: Looking for Artist for Character Art Cards
content:
LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST!

I’m looking for an artist to work with one of my author clients on character art cards for multiple books. We have quite a few projects in the works, so I’d love to connect with someone interested in an ongoing working relationship and multiple commissions!

Here’s what we’re looking for:

- Character art/cards for books

- Budget: Under $100 per art piece

- Multiple pieces across multiple books

- Must be available to start now!

- NO AI-GENERATED ART. Human artists only, please!

If you’re an artist whose style might be a good fit, please drop your portfolio or commission sheet in the comments, along with your pricing and current availability!

If you know an artist who might be interested, please tag them or share this post.

We’d love to find someone whose art we can keep coming back to as these projects grow!

Contact: Drop portfolio in comments or DM as indicated.
